throughline.zh: 新加坡 SG6 機房正式開幕，奇鋐越南公告工程支出，緯穎與其他台灣業者揭露跨境投資，而台灣記憶體廠相關協商仍未結束。
throughline.en: SG6 opened in Singapore, AVC disclosed Vietnam construction spending, Taiwanese manufacturers announced cross-border funding, and memory-fab labor talks in Taiwan remained unresolved.

title.zh: 資料中心開幕、電力與機房融資
title.en: Data-center openings, power and facility financing

summary.zh: 11 月 6 日 Equinix 啟用新加坡 SG6，一期提供 8MW IT 容量，與先前馬來西亞 PDG 柔佛融資、雅加達機房開幕共同構成不同工程階段的資料中心動態。台灣電力規劃與通訊備援仍按各自公告日期呈現。
summary.en: Equinix opened Singapore SG6 with 8MW phase-one IT capacity on November 6, adding an operational milestone to earlier Johor financing and Jakarta data-center openings. Taiwan grid plans and telecom backup remain separately dated developments.

title.zh: 封裝、記憶體供應與研發合作
title.en: Packaging, memory supply and R&D cooperation

summary.zh: 台灣高階封測與石英材料投資於 11 月 5 日通過，11 月 6 日美光桃園勞資調解未達成協議，仍需另行查證施工情況。臻鼎、矽格與創見的財報及記憶體報價說法使用不同期間，台美產業研發合作則進入徵案準備。
summary.en: Taiwan approved advanced packaging and quartz investments on November 5, while Micron's Taoyuan mediation ended without agreement on November 6; construction status remains separately unverified. Zhen Ding, Sigurd and Transcend reported different financial and memory periods, alongside a new Taiwan-US R&D call.

title.zh: 東南亞封測與液冷製造工程
title.en: Southeast Asian testing and liquid-cooling construction

summary.zh: FPT 在越南進行晶片封測試產、Ferrotec 居林第二廠公布擴建細節；11 月 6 日奇鋐越南子公司再披露機電與配套工程合約。各項消息分別涵蓋試產、廠房設計及工程合約，不代表相同驗收或量產進度。
summary.en: FPT reported Vietnamese semiconductor testing trials and Ferrotec detailed its second Kulim plant. On November 6 AVC disclosed Vietnam electrical and ancillary works, covering a different stage from customer acceptance or volume production.

title.zh: 伺服器營收與馬來西亞、越南製造資金
title.en: Server sales and Malaysian/Vietnamese manufacturing funding

summary.zh: 研華、英業達、鴻海與上銀陸續公布接單、營收及設備零件供應資訊，11 月 6 日緯創公布 10 月營收約 4,026 億元。緯穎馬來西亞及佳世達越南子公司亦公布增資，資金用途與實際設備採購須區分。
summary.en: Advantech, Inventec, Hon Hai and Hiwin disclosed backlog, sales and component conditions, while Wistron reported October sales near NT$402.6 billion on November 6. Wiwynn's Malaysian and Qisda's Vietnamese subsidiaries announced financing that should not be treated as tool procurement.

title.zh: 電源、材料與跨境工業投資
title.en: Power, materials and cross-border industrial investment

summary.zh: 華新麗華先前公告能源設備合作及其他台灣公司對東南亞子公司投資，11 月 6 日再決議規劃在越南設立 3,000 萬美元的精密不銹鋼材料子公司。台塑新智能的儲能增資規劃仍依公告狀態標示，未視為已投產產能。
summary.en: Walsin's earlier equipment collaboration and regional industrial investments were followed on November 6 by a planned US$30 million Vietnamese precision-materials subsidiary. Formosa Smart Energy's battery financing remains a plan rather than commissioned output.
